node.label: John Higham
node.date_label: Strangers in the Land (1955) · “The Cult of the American Consensus” (1959) · Send These to Me (1975)
node.description: A historian of American nativism, ethnicity and historiography who combined a commitment to pluralist democracy with criticism of flattened consensus narratives. Dorothy Ross’s retrospective also notes his unease with later fragmentation, rather than assigning him a single unchanging position.
